family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal of bacterial regulatory ATPase RavA (Regulatory ATPase variant A) [[cite:PUB00091615],[cite:PUB00097491]] and is the second subdomain that forms the discontinuous triple helical domain [[cite:PUB00091615]]. RavA forms an hexamer in which the triple helical domain mediates the lateral interactions between neighbouring RavA monomers [[cite:PUB00097491]].
family.name: ATPase, RavA, C-terminal
